events.title: The Inside Job demo is coming – play it at Steam Next Fest
events.summary: The doors open soon.We are releasing a free demo of Inside Job - and we are part of Steam Next Fest, October 19-26.What you are getting intoA co-op prison escape for 1-4 players. The walls, the schedule, the guards - every one of them is a problem you have to solve yourselves. Nobody tells you how.Keep your head downThe day runs on a schedule, and the guards expect you to follow it. Be where you should be, when you should be. events.title: LAST COUNT: no teams, only one walks out – free in the demo
events.summary: Only one walks out.LAST COUNT is the second mode in Inside Job. Up to ten inmates, no teams, no allies. Just you, everyone else, and the Director."Look at you. The scum of society."The Director runs the evening, and he makes the rules. Every room is a new game, and every game ends the same way: somebody does not make it.Room after roomThe tower lights turn red - whoever still moves is out.
